summary.text: Joni Tschetter is the Republican candidate for the South Dakota House of Representatives, District 15, in the November 3, 2026 general election; the Republican primary was canceled.
She has run for the seat before, in 2022 and 2024, and has described herself as a small business owner in Sioux Falls.

paragraphs.text: Joni Tschetter was a Republican candidate for District 15 of the South Dakota House in the 2022 general election, which Linda Duba and Kadyn Wittman won, and again in 2024, when she placed third of four candidates for the two seats.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Tschetter said she and her husband Ron live in Sioux Falls District 15, have three sons, and have owned businesses for more than 15 years.
She said she supports economic development that creates jobs, supports education and lowers taxes, and described herself as a believer in the Second Amendment.
